baseline: number of pixels >=8 /4 (floor); number of central 4x4 pixels >=8 /3 (floor)
caveats: Original labels are public (operationally withheld in selection, not externally sealed).
Data is preexisting and not truly novel scientific discovery.
Only 3 vs 8 subset; coarse representation deliberately chosen; no claim about all-digit generalization.
frozen_procedure: No feature changes, new thresholds, or selection after holdout reveal
learner: categorical-signature class frequency with Laplace-like shrinkage to training prior
raw_features: 8x8 pixel intensity >=8; zero-indexed flattened pixel indices
train_selection: 4-fold stratified CV Brier score, all variable pixels and all pairs
